crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, ovoid region of exposed red skin visible at the superior margin of the plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Abrupt and distinct horizontal boundary separating bare red skin from dark gray mantle feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white plumage patch on the lower rump and upper tail coverts.
